# The product informs, you decide; nothing blocks

> A product that dictates workflow gets worked around on the first urgent day, and then the information is lost along with the block.

Applies to `crates/bancada-rules/**`, `web/src/pages/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **Blocking on unsatisfied preconditions** (nothing refuses it) — False confidence, and it gets disabled. Whoever wants to bypass it opens a terminal.
- **Hard limits on WIP, diff size or resources** (nothing refuses it) — The same, plus it punishes legitimate work.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. A rule can see that code exists, not that it refuses. Whether a check blocks or merely reports is behaviour, not shape.
